description: Test helper functions and setup code for user-related unit tests in the Mattermost server, including user creation, test environment setup, and configuration adjustments.

classes.name: TestHelper
classes.description: Helper struct for setting up and managing user tests, including user creation and environment configuration.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service responsible for user operations, referenced within TestHelper.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including database and configuration setup.

methods.name: setupTestHelper
methods.description: Configures a test helper with temporary workspace, configuration, and cleanup procedures.

methods.name: InitBasic
methods.description: Initializes basic users for testing, including a system admin and two regular users.

methods.name: CreateUser
methods.description: Creates a new user for testing purposes.

methods.name: CreateGuest
methods.description: Creates a new guest user for testing purposes.

methods.name: CreateUserOrGuest
methods.description: Creates either a regular or guest user based on the guest flag.
